author: Les Brown
quotes: Your current position is not the full measure of your possibility.
A dream remains alive as long as you continue feeding it action.
Do not let another person’s limitation become your personal prophecy.
Life can knock you down without receiving permission to keep you there.
You possess abilities that comfort may never ask you to discover.
Begin before confidence arrives and let progress introduce you.
Your circumstances are a chapter, not the title of your life.
The voice of possibility must become louder than the memory of failure.
Give yourself permission to outgrow the expectations surrounding you.
You do not need to know the entire road before taking the first step.
Failure is an experience you had, not a person you became.
The dream may require a version of you that does not exist yet.
Keep moving until your actions catch up with your imagination.
Your future deserves more loyalty than your fear.
Do not die with useful gifts still hidden inside you.
Belief opens the door, but committed effort must walk through it.
It is possible to begin again without pretending the past never happened.
The world may not understand your vision before you build evidence for it.
Speak to yourself like someone whose future still matters.
Your comeback can begin in the same place where confidence collapsed.
Do not surrender the dream because the path became unfamiliar.
You have survived enough to stop underestimating your resilience.
Let rejection redirect your effort rather than reduce your worth.
The next chapter needs courage more than it needs certainty.
Continue becoming the person capable of carrying the life you imagine.
